method_note: This audit is re-anchored to the current task worktree at /Users/nathan/.folia-fleets/grwl-raw-release-20261102/tree. An earlier read first consulted bulkdata's FFR r2 package copy and stale .local/clean-clone-r1 plastic/status material; those locations were not used as evidence for this record. Current task-worktree canonical records, release reports, and READMEs were inspected and their SHA-256 values recorded below. No source data were downloaded, and no builds, tests, live GEE calls, or network requests were run during this audit.

summary.main_conclusion: Neither prepared conversion shows the GRWL-style shortcut of feeding an already simplified summary into an analytic mirror. Both use checksum-pinned producer archives and retain the intended analytical records/fields; the river-plastic product is deliberately the historical Lebreton 2017 model with a 2010 baseline, not a claim to be the latest river-plastic estimate.
summary.material_caveat: The normalizer writes clean_checkout_independently_verified=false unconditionally (bind_fidelity.py line351). Matching rebuilt asset hashes and saved clean-checkout observations are present. This flag is a conservative normalizer limitation, not evidence of a failed rebuild; it does not independently re-establish the saved checkout provenance.
summary.scientific_validation_boundary: Conversion fidelity and published-summary consistency do not independently establish scientific or observational accuracy. GEE value/geometry comparisons are dataset parity checks, not scientific ground truth.

source.product: Grill et al. (2019), Figshare article 10.6084/m9.figshare.7688801.v1, file 15090536

selected_scope.attributes: All 38 source attributes plus producer FID OBJECTID; source_row is added as an ordinal. r2 appends derived bbox values. Source order, multiplicity, nulls, attributes, and WKB are reported preserved.
selected_scope.time_scope: Static 2019 assessment built from source data assembled circa 2017; not a current river-connectivity observation.

validation.source_fidelity: Passed complete source reread: all 8,477,883 rows and 38 source attributes; source archive SHA is bound to the report.
validation.rebuild: Raw reproduction report passed; clean-rebuild summary says raw/final hashes match, and source values/nulls/WKB compare in both spatial augmentation reports. However clean_checkout_independently_verified is explicitly false in that same report; this is an unresolved report-field inconsistency.
validation.fault_tests: Five deliberate raw conversion faults rejected.
validation.package_checks: Final package verification passed with no failures; Portolan/STAC checks passed; loopback HTTP range/CORS and DuckDB subset check passed.
validation.display: PMTiles is separate from analytic GeoParquet. The current display manifest accounts for all 8,477,883 source IDs at maxzoom; geometry checking is sampled, not exhaustive. Display simplification/quantization is not an analytical source substitution.
not_checked: Independent scientific or observational accuracy of the producer assessment.
Public hosting, remote ranges, or registry acceptance.

free-flowing-rivers.assessment: No source-selection or analytical-detail shortcut found. Residual issue is evidentiary wording around the contradictory clean-checkout boolean; it does not reverse the passed complete source fidelity report.

source.product: Lebreton et al. (2017), Figshare v6, DOI 10.6084/m9.figshare.4725541.v6

selected_scope.geography: Worldwide river input points, WGS84 longitude/latitude; source bbox [-137.9375, -55.62083333, 179.8791667, 60.4125].
selected_scope.fields: All 53 original numeric fields, original point coordinates, four rows with null modeled emission/runoff values, and all 19 coincident-coordinate groups are retained. Derived source_row and bbox are added; rows are Hilbert-sorted for spatial access.
selected_scope.time_scope: Historical model baseline 2010. Explicitly not current measurements and explicitly distinct from the later Meijer et al. (2021) model.
selected_scope.display_scope: PMTiles intentionally quantizes positions, stores selected attributes as doubles, and thins at lower zooms; GeoParquet is the analytical source.

validation.source_fidelity: Passed exact comparison of all 2,160,280 numeric cells and all 40,760 source geometries.
validation.reproducibility: Passed two same-machine builds from identical committed code/environment; not a cross-platform claim.

gee_comparison.strict_replay: Failed, preserved as failed; 40,760 positions were not uniquely matched under the registered strict coordinate tolerance.
gee_comparison.final_diagnostic: Passed only under the separately declared exact-coincident-group multiset contract: 2,160,076 exact numeric matches and 204 matching nulls; maximum displacement 0.349456389 m. Strict parity and unique-only geodesic parity remain failed.
gee_comparison.provenance_limit: Captured GEE metadata does not identify upstream release/version or provide an ingestion manifest. A one-metre table-ingestion transform is only a plausible explanation, not demonstrated cause.

validation.published_summary_checks: Passed checks for global annual bounds, May–October share, nonnegative values, and ordered uncertainty intervals.
not_checked: Independent observational validation of the model.
Top-20 named-river or regional-share crosswalk; source lacks river names and watershed IDs.
Public hosting and remote endpoint behavior.

river-plastic-inputs.assessment: No lower-detail substitute was selected for this conversion: the complete pinned v6 product is mirrored. The dataset is older than the distinct 2021 Meijer model, but the canonical title, README, release README, and provenance explicitly frame it as Lebreton 2017 / 2010 and not current; do not present it as the latest estimate.

grip.scope: Complete GRIP4-2018 global roads, seven regional partitions, 25,758,453 source rows; historical research inventory, not current roads.
grip.current_alternative: Overture is preferred for current roads; not claimed as an exact GRIP mirror or proved superset.
grip.validation: The retained local validation compared 309,101,436 cells including FID/WKB and all rows. Seven analytic partitions matched in the stopped rebuild; full rebuild/reproducibility is not verified. Package not created; GEE and remote hosting not tested.
grip.selection_note: Local conversion exists as validated research work, but triage defers publication. Do not label it a prepared publication.

jrc-gsw-occurrence.scope: JRC Global Surface Water Occurrence v1.5, 1984–2024; 504 producer-hosted TIFFs totaling 14,453,956,859 bytes.
jrc-gsw-occurrence.conversion: No local raster conversion or payload download; decision is reuse existing producer-hosted assets, not duplicate Source Cooperative mirror.
jrc-gsw-occurrence.validation: Eight geographically varied bounded range/TIFF probes totaling 280,640 response bytes support tiled TIFFs with overviews and COG-like layout. Exhaustive COG conformance and scientific pixel validation are not run.
jrc-gsw-occurrence.scope_note: Occurrence is a multi-decade frequency product ending in 2024, not a current-date water map. Related recent products are documented as complements, not equivalents.

gdw.scope: Intended complete Global Dam Watch consensus v1.0 barriers and reservoir polygons, all producer attributes and shared identifiers.
gdw.validation: Official Figshare/API/direct-file requests returned HTTP 403. Source archive not acquired; no schema/source conversion validation and no output manifest.
gdw.not_equivalent_alternatives: AquaScope is a selected-attribute barrier table lacking geometry metadata and reservoirs; JRC v1_delta is a different edition. Neither is a verified complete substitute.

swot_prior_lake_database.scope: Scientific SWOT Prior Lake Database v2.03 only: 61 SQLite tiles, nine regions, 29,990,277,120 provider-declared bytes; excludes v2.02 and Light/Geometries variants.
swot_prior_lake_database.validation: Public metadata and one 16-byte HTTP 206 SQLite-header read succeeded. No complete tile, checksum, schema, or global table content validated. Inspection stopped at 39.37 GiB free (<40 GiB start floor); dataset exceeds 8 GiB retained-storage budget. No output manifest or conversion.
